newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Transport sees trucking unit profit.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Transport sees trucking unit profit.

text.p: U.S. Transportation Systems Inc said Wednesday it expects its trucking and package delivery divisions to be profitable in the second and third quarters.
The company's forecast followed first quarter operating losses of more than $314,000 or $0.04 per share.

In a statement, Chief Executive Michael Margolies said, "Costs associated with consolidating our trucking and package delivery divisions contributed to the loss from continued operations. We expect these divisions to contribute to profitability in the second and third quarters."
The company also said its previously announced merger with Precept Investors is proceeding according to schedule.
